verdicts.reason: The two layouts are nearly identical. Both shrink the doctor illustration to a tiny figure while the sparkle grows into an oversized focal point that competes with it. Both break the headline awkwardly as '6 / SYMPTOMS', and the symptom list runs items together ('Shortness of breath Dry cough', 'Sore throat Headache'). A's hashtag badge keeps the original's yellow fill with dark text. B's badge looks recoloured and has less contrast, which weakens the brand slightly, so A wins by a small margin.
